mapper.select:
select (select count(*) from patient where status = "ENABLE") as patientCount, (select count(*) from study where status = "ENABLE") as studyCount, (select count(*) from task where status = "ENABLE") as taskCount,
(SELECT ROUND((today_count - yesterday_count) * 100.0 / yesterday_count, 2) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE status = "ENABLE") AS today_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE status = "ENABLE" and DATE(created_at) < CURDATE()) AS yesterday_count ) AS counts) AS patient_increase,
(SELECT ROUND((today_count - yesterday_count) * 100.0 / yesterday_count, 2) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE status = "ENABLE") AS today_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study WHERE status = "ENABLE" and DATE(created_at) < CURDATE()) AS yesterday_count ) AS counts) AS study_increase,
(SELECT ROUND((today_count - yesterday_count) * 100.0 / yesterday_count, 2) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE status = "ENABLE") AS today_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE status = "ENABLE" and DATE(created_at) < CURDATE()) AS yesterday_count ) AS counts) AS task_increase;

SELECT (select count(*) FROM patient where status = "ENABLE" and age <= 14) as youth_num, (select count(*) FROM patient where status = "ENABLE" and age between 15 and 65) as adult_num, (select count(*) FROM patient where status = "ENABLE" and age > 65) as elderly_num;

select id as task_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, finished_at) as consumed_time from task where status = "ENABLE" and type = "PROCESS" and task_status = "FINISHED" ORDER BY finished_at desc limit 20;
